facts: Mobileye announced participation in Evercore's 9th Annual ADAS, AV & AI Forum on September 29, 2026.
The same notice listed Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 8, 2026.

sources.origin: SEC EDGAR / Mobileye furnished Q2 2026 results
facts: Q2 2026 revenue was $508 million.
Full-year 2026 revenue guidance was narrowed to $1.970-$2.020 billion with midpoint raised by $20 million.
Adjusted operating-income guidance improvement was partly related to an Israeli R&D incentive grant.
Mobileye segment revenue was $507 million in Q2 2026, flat versus Q2 2025.
YTD 2026 Mobileye revenue was $1.1 billion, up $120 million year over year primarily from higher EyeQ demand.

sources.origin: Mobileye Investor Relations / vertically integrated robotaxi announcement
facts: Mobileye plans a vertically integrated autonomous ride-hailing business in a U.S. city in 2027.
The initiative adds fleet operations, rider services and mobility management while continuing supplier programs.

sources.origin: Mobileye Investor Relations / DMS production program announcement
facts: A leading U.S. automaker selected Mobileye DMS integrated with EyeQ6L for production targeted in 2027.
Mobileye expects the program to span millions of vehicles across multiple models and model years.
Q2 revenue was $508 million.
Full-year revenue outlook was narrowed to $1.97-$2.02 billion and midpoint increased by $20 million.
Operating cash flow for the first six months was $210 million.

Mobileye disclosed a high-volume Stellantis Cloud-Enhanced ADAS design win and said gross profit per unit is roughly equivalent to Surround ADAS and more than double current average base ADAS profitability.
Adjusted operating-income guidance improvement was primarily related to an R&D incentive grant.

sources.origin: Mobileye Investor Relations / vertically integrated robotaxi announcement
facts: Mobileye plans to launch a vertically integrated autonomous ride-hailing business in a U.S. city in 2027.
The model combines self-driving technology with fleet operations, rider services and mobility management.
The initiative is additive to Mobileye's existing automaker and mobility-partner programs.
Q1 revenue was $558 million, up 27% year over year.
Management raised the midpoint of full-year 2026 revenue guidance by 2%.
Operating cash flow was $75 million in Q1 2026.
Mentee Robotics acquisition reduced cash by $591 million net of cash acquired.
Board authorized up to $250 million of share repurchases.
Q1 GAAP operating loss included a $3.788 billion non-cash goodwill impairment.
